# Step 1: Login (reuse if already available) and export unique songs from song library

# Get Spotify access token if not already present
if 'sp_token' not in globals() or not isinstance(globals().get('sp_token'), str):
    sp_pw = None
    for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
        if x['account_name'] == 'spotify':
            sp_pw = x['password']
            break
    login_res = apis.spotify.login(username='ka_burt@gmail.com', password=sp_pw)
    sp_token = login_res['access_token']

# Collect songs from show_song_library with pagination
song_info_by_id = globals().get('song_info_by_id', {})

page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
pages_loaded = 0
new_songs_added_total = 0

while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=sp_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    pages_loaded += 1
    if not page:
        break
    for s in page:
        sid = s.get('song_id')
        title = s.get('title')
        artists = s.get('artists') or []
        artist_names = [a.get('name') for a in artists if a and a.get('name') is not None]
        artists_str = '|'.join(artist_names)
        if sid not in song_info_by_id:
            song_info_by_id[sid] = {'title': title, 'artists': artists_str}
            new_songs_added_total += 1
    page_index += 1

print('song_library_pages_loaded_including_empty_last', pages_loaded)
print('unique_songs_in_song_library_collected', len(song_info_by_id))
print('new_songs_added_in_this_step', new_songs_added_total)
print('sample_1', next(iter(song_info_by_id.items())) if song_info_by_id else None)

# Ensure we have song_info_by_id and all_song_ids from previous steps if present
song_info_by_id = globals().get('song_info_by_id', {})
all_song_ids = globals().get('all_song_ids', None)
missing_ids = globals().get('missing_ids', None)

if all_song_ids is None or missing_ids is None:
    # Recompute minimal: all_song_ids = song_library_ids | album_song_ids | playlist_song_ids
    song_library_ids=set(song_info_by_id.keys())
    # These may not exist; cannot recompute without re-fetching; just raise.
    raise Exception('Missing computation context for all_song_ids/missing_ids')

missing_ids_to_fetch = [sid for sid in missing_ids if sid not in song_info_by_id]
print('missing_ids_to_fetch_count', len(missing_ids_to_fetch))

sp_pw=None
for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if x['account_name']=='spotify':
        sp_pw=x['password']
        break

failures=[]

def relogin():
    nonlocal sp_token
    sp_token = apis.spotify.login(username='ka_burt@gmail.com', password=sp_pw)['access_token']

for i, sid in enumerate(missing_ids_to_fetch):
    try:
        sd = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        # show_song params: song_id; access_token optional per docs. We'll try with explicit access_token for consistency.
    except Exception as e:
        # Retry with access_token and re-login on 401
        msg=str(e)
        if '401' in msg or 'not authorized' in msg or 'access token' in msg.lower():
            relogin()
        try:
            sd = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid, access_token=sp_token)
        except Exception as e2:
            failures.append({'song_id': sid, 'error': str(e2)})
            continue

    title = sd.get('title')
    artists = sd.get('artists') or []
    artist_names = [a.get('name') for a in artists if a and a.get('name') is not None]
    artists_str='|'.join(artist_names)
    song_info_by_id[sid] = {'title': title, 'artists': artists_str}

    if (i+1) % 10 == 0 or (i+1)==len(missing_ids_to_fetch):
        print('fetched', i+1, 'of', len(missing_ids_to_fetch), 'current_missing_remaining', len(missing_ids_to_fetch)-(i+1))

print('failures_count', len(failures))
print('song_info_by_id_final_count', len(song_info_by_id))
# Verify coverage
missing_after = [sid for sid in all_song_ids if sid not in song_info_by_id]
print('missing_after_count', len(missing_after))
print('missing_after_sample', missing_after[:10])

# Write spotify.csv with unique songs (from song library + album library + playlists)

from pathlib import PurePosixPath

def csv_escape(val):
    s = '' if val is None else str(val)
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',','\n','\r','"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

song_info_by_id = globals().get('song_info_by_id')
print('song_info_by_id_count', len(song_info_by_id) if song_info_by_id else None)

# Build deterministic ordering
items = list(song_info_by_id.items())
# sort by title, then artists, then song_id
items.sort(key=lambda x: ((x[1].get('title') or ''), (x[1].get('artists') or ''), x[0]))

lines = ['Title,Artists']
for sid, info in items:
    title = info.get('title') or ''
    artists = info.get('artists') or ''
    lines.append(csv_escape(title) + ',' + csv_escape(artists))

content = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
print('csv_total_lines_including_header', len(lines))
